تستوزرون (form X)
# تَسْتَوْزِرُونَ (tastawzirūna) /tas.taw.zi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# تُسْتَوْزَرُونَ (tustawzarūna) /tus.taw.za.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
